description: Function OS candidate architecture overlay - maps external research paradigms to ignition architecture nodes

1_FunctionSpec.definition: Formal specification of a function including preconditions, postconditions, effect signature, and uncertainty model
1_FunctionSpec.existing_correspondence: Markdown files in 统一函数总表/
1_FunctionSpec.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ would be the root FunctionSpec
1_FunctionSpec.evidence_relationship: FunctionSpec determines what evidence is needed for CLAIM_SUPPORT_CONFIRMED
1_FunctionSpec.table_relationship: Each entry in 统一函数总表 becomes a FunctionSpec
1_FunctionSpec.local_model_relationship: QClaw/Hermes can read FunctionSpec to understand function behavior
1_FunctionSpec.failure_and_rollback: Specification violation → reject execution, log to error trace
1_FunctionSpec.security_boundary: FunctionSpec is read-only after freeze; modifications require IGNITION task
1_FunctionSpec.minimal_prototype: JSON schema with fields: name, definition, preconditions, postconditions, effect_signature, uncertainty_model
1_FunctionSpec.status: CANDIDATE - needs field enhancement to existing markdown

2_Representation.definition: Machine-readable encoding of a function (weights, code, mathematical formula, AST)
2_Representation.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ is represented as mathematical formula
2_Representation.evidence_relationship: Representation determines what validation regime applies
2_Representation.table_relationship: Each function table entry has a representation
2_Representation.failure_and_rollback: Encoding failure → fall back to documentation-only mode
2_Representation.minimal_prototype: LaTeX/MathML formula string + optional Python reference implementation
2_Representation.status: PARTIAL - markdown + LaTeX exists, no machine-readable format

3_Compiler.definition: Transforms FunctionSpec + Representation into executable artifact
3_Compiler.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ would need a compiler to become executable
3_Compiler.local_model_relationship: QClaw could serve as compiler for LLM-interpretable functions
3_Compiler.failure_and_rollback: Compilation failure → log error, keep specification-only mode
3_Compiler.minimal_prototype: Python function that evaluates Ψ₀ given parameters

4_Artifact.existing_correspondence: 085 frozen v1 JSON is a partial artifact
4_Artifact.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ definition file is an uncompiled artifact
4_Artifact.local_model_relationship: Artifacts can be loaded by local models
4_Artifact.failure_and_rollback: Artifact corruption → rollback to previous version
4_Artifact.minimal_prototype: JSON file with: name, version, sha256, representation, compiled_output
4_Artifact.status: PARTIAL - 085 frozen v1 exists, no general artifact system

5_Interpreter.definition: Executes function artifact with given inputs
5_Interpreter.existing_correspondence: None - no interpreter exists for ignition functions
5_Interpreter.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ needs an interpreter to compute values
5_Interpreter.local_model_relationship: QClaw/Hermes can act as LLM-based interpreter
5_Interpreter.failure_and_rollback: Runtime error → catch, log, return failure
5_Interpreter.security_boundary: Interpreter runs in sandbox with resource limits
5_Interpreter.minimal_prototype: Python evaluator for Ψ₀ mathematical formulas

6_ExecutionTrace.definition: Detailed log of function execution including inputs, outputs, intermediate states, and timing
6_ExecutionTrace.evidence_relationship: Execution traces are evidence for validation
6_ExecutionTrace.local_model_relationship: Traces can be analyzed by local models for debugging
6_ExecutionTrace.failure_and_rollback: Trace storage failure → continue without trace (degraded mode)
6_ExecutionTrace.security_boundary: Traces must not leak sensitive input data
6_ExecutionTrace.minimal_prototype: JSON log with: timestamp, function_id, inputs, outputs, duration, status

7_Validator.definition: Validates function artifacts against specifications and evidence
7_Validator.psi0_relationship: Validates that Ψ₀ is correctly implemented
7_Validator.failure_and_rollback: Validation failure → non-zero exit, block promotion
7_Validator.minimal_prototype: Python script that checks JSON schema and hash integrity

8_ComposerRouter.definition: Composes and routes between multiple functions based on task requirements
8_ComposerRouter.psi0_relationship: Would compose Ψ₀ with other functions for complex tasks
8_ComposerRouter.local_model_relationship: QClaw can act as composer for LLM-interpretable functions
8_ComposerRouter.failure_and_rollback: Composition failure → fall back to single-function execution

9_VersionedRegistry.definition: Central registry of all function artifacts with version history and provenance
9_VersionedRegistry.existing_correspondence: Git repository serves as informal registry
9_VersionedRegistry.psi0_relationship: Ψ₀ would be registered as version 1.0
9_VersionedRegistry.evidence_relationship: Registry tracks which evidence supports which version
9_VersionedRegistry.minimal_prototype: JSON index file with: function_id, version, sha256, file_path, provenance
9_VersionedRegistry.status: PARTIAL - git provides versioning, no machine-readable registry

data_flow: FunctionSpec → Representation → Compiler → Artifact → Interpreter → ExecutionTrace → Validator → ComposerRouter → VersionedRegistry
overall_assessment: 3 nodes PARTIAL (FunctionSpec, Artifact, Validator), 1 node CANDIDATE (Representation), 5 nodes MISSING (Compiler, Interpreter, ExecutionTrace, ComposerRouter, VersionedRegistry). The Function OS is aspirational - current ignition architecture is documentation-first, not execution-first.
